operations.domain_and_required_checks: f32/f64 ALPN_AUTO chooses by rowgroup sampling. Read actual ALN1 decimal/RD/raw group and vector kinds plus decimal exception bits; verify regime changes, tails, and FE_TONEAREST. Raw group output does not record the rejected candidate scheme.

Record build/width/CPU availability, requested versus selected dispatch, and actual available native counters per wire branch. FALP decimal kernel can have zero work on RD/raw. Native SIMD counter is AVX2-only; unavailable targets are rejected, not counted.

entries.unsupported_platform_m6: GPU and non-frozen-platform ISA are not part of Linux CPU initial platform; actual native support recorded separately.

operations.domain_and_required_checks: Full build pc_compress and pc_decompress_bounded dispatch to Rust Source. Exercise f16 including special bits, all typed V inputs, and independent restoration with default options; do not infer Auto mode/fallback.
Explicit C NativeAuto encoder with the full build Rust Source decoder. Different plugin envelope. Reject f16; never label this a pure C roundtrip.
Whole-chunk metadata training; full compressed pages supplied before incremental output. Per-page limit, detached recovery with metadata, missing-metadata and drain rejection.
Same page workload via pcn_* with cumulative decoder output limit. Distinct state/ownership; not an online stream.
Full build uses TryIntMult. Verify emitted IntMult, size fallback to Classic and exact uint64 base in chunk metadata separately from Auto; reject invalid base and float.
u8/u16, FIRE, 1–128 channels subject to entry/message bounds; actual lowdim/generic SIMD and frame/payload separated; f64 limbs are external.
Unsigned COUNT/SUM/MAX, actual generic AVX2 and applicable lowdim fallback; preserve shape and accumulator semantics.

TCHY v2 batch baseline 64/4/1000; adapter exposes 8/16/32/64-bit unsigned values at fixed 4/1000 and no implicit bitcast, restores true count and checks native/envelope agreement. Other native options remain to be verified.

Stateful sample push / packet pop. Verify early packets, backpressure retry, reset, tail and cumulative decoder padded-value quota; the encoder LRU is logical, not a decoder or total-memory cap. Charge packet framing and all TSC1 configuration.

Reader opens immutable read_at backing (memory callback or FILE), validates header/index once; point/bit/range validate only touched pairs. Count actual callback requests separately at open and per query; not physical disk I/O.
Each stateless invocation validates the entire container before reconstructing intersecting chunks; verify unrelated bad split rejection, quota, capacity and bounds separately from a reused reader.
Native int64 T and f64 V; check declared maximum per message, timestamp/delta edges and bitwise V.
Track append state and snapshot/resume costs; scan/copy of old frame cannot be omitted.
Validate iterator and forward seek without index/random access attribution.
Serial 1D reversible i32/i64/f32/f64; predeclared dtype and nonempty count, typed alignment, raw word-padded payload and independently restored external schema. Raw decode is trusted-artifact only.
1–4D direct field diagnostics with nonoverlap, signed/permuted strides and untouched padding; separate requested, effective and observed quality for reversible, rate, precision and floating accuracy.
Compare serial and OpenMP 1/2 for the same reversible field, instrument actual native full-block work by thread ID, keep decode serial and verify policy restoration.

Separate aligned fixed-rate array format and metadata. Inspect cached exact writes versus post-eviction/flush quality, cross-block ranges and reopen; set_cache_size only flushes in this frozen source.

entries.unsupported_platform_m6: GPU and non-frozen-platform ISA are not part of Linux CPU initial platform; actual native support recorded separately.

operations.domain_and_required_checks: Legacy LN_ZSTD level 3, 0..65536 input bytes, bound-sized destination, precise original length on decode, default synchronous frame with content size on and checksum off.
Required native process with caller spans, bounded progress, repeated finish, directional reset, independent frame decode and truncation rejection; streaming session rejects the batch-only methods.

Required trainer and dictionary load for both directions. Separate samples and held-out input; retain dictionary identity and actual bytes; fresh-process decode rejects missing or wrong trained dictionary.
Conditional native encoder workers on an eligible frame and build. Record jobs and distinct worker identities with a synchronous control; the selected decode path does not expose workers.
Legacy LN_XZ preset 6, 0..65536 input bytes, CHECK_NONE, threads=1. Decode trusts precise original length, ignores payload checks and sets a 256 MiB stop limit.

Required framed process with caller spans, repeat finish and directional reset. Verify multi-block LZMA2, checks, admissible filters and memory limits; distinguish rejected configurations from valid ones. No external dictionary.

Conditional on block eligibility, memory and build. Observe encoder and decoder native hooks separately. Control decoder comparison on the same multi-block stream; a configuration count alone is not proof.

Macro SF_DECLARE generates sf_c_create/encode/decode/reset; 1–1000 non-NaN f32/f64 per native block. selfstar-batch uses the Unique 512-value boundary with a short tail and a fresh initial state per object; consecutive native blocks retain same-column learning.

Macro SF_LIVE_DECLARE generates begin/add/finish/read_begin/next/progress. Separate bits written into the borrowed buffer from a finished immutable block; consume the sentinel before reading the next block. Direct controls verify batch/live parity at block boundaries, reset and ordered replay. No partial-input reader or flush-to-consumer promise.

Codec(Algorithm::Huff) FEC1: 32 KiB independent u8 blocks with per-block CRC. Read raw/RLE/Huffman tags and count actual BMI2-aware decoder calls only for Huffman blocks. Frozen release defaults dynamic ON; portable OFF is a distinct build.

TableCodec ETB1: train on nonempty <=32 KiB bytes, serialize and reload exact model identity, then independently restore 1X/4X blocks in reverse order. Count model bytes and 9-byte record headers; shared blocks have no CRC. Observe actual usingCTable/usingDTable entries, not generic SIMD or threads.

Local C++ reproduction exposed by C ABI. Finite f64 under FE_TONEAREST; 1–16 positive strictly decreasing eps, bounded value-layer work. Verify full PBEP and detached prefixes, exact original-domain absolute error at each level, advertised/effective bounds and corrupt-layer rejection; observed errors need not be monotone.

Finite replayable input; count passes, first sink write, source/sink bytes and temporary logical stdio, verify against batch and inject changed source/rewind/sink failures. Not single-pass online, physical I/O, or random access.

Finite column-major f64 with ordered columns; verify model identity before encode, model save/load, independent data-frame decode, original-column quality and short tails. CRD1 re-embeds model data in every frame, has no checksum, and does not carry column names; threshold is not a pointwise error bound.

Separate native C11 training; bind train-only data, normalization and explicit column mask/seed/sample caps; independently validate LARS and coordinate descent KKT, sparse nonconvergence and bounded model construction. Report outer-iteration completion separately from sparse-solver convergence.

Execute the frozen sklearn Source bridge in locked tsbench, bind train-only tricklets, keep input, dictionary and packed model identities, then validate native inference on disjoint held-out columns. Unmodified bridge RNG is not frozen; no numerical or byte equivalence to C training.
